title: Unique Dense Irish Chestnut Wrap
description: A savory Irish dish featuring cooked chestnuts and leaf-wrapped steam cooking, low in sodium. This recipe showcases the richness of Irish cuisine with a unique twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the chopped chestnuts with 1 tablespoon of olive oil and salt-free seasoning until they are evenly coated.
Spread the chestnuts on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until they are tender.
While the chestnuts are roasting, sauté the chopped onion and carrots in the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat until they are tender.
Add the chopped potatoes to the pan and continue to cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Once the chestnuts are done roasting, let them cool slightly, then add them to the pan with the onion, carrots, and potatoes.
Stir in the black pepper and continue to cook for 1 minute.
To assemble the wraps, lay a large kale leaf flat on a work surface and spoon about 1/2 cup of the chestnut and vegetable mixture onto the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end of the kale leaf over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining kale leaves and filling.
Place the wraps in a steamer basket and steam over boiling water for 5 minutes, or until the kale is tender.
